NBA DFS Picks for Monday, October 26 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Monday, October 26 · 7 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 26, 7:47 PM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Monday, October 26 DraftKings main slate at 57.2 DraftKings points for $9,900. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 54.0, $9,500) and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 49.4, $9,800) are next.

Jay Huff (IND) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 7.00 projected points per $1,000 at $3,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 26, 7:47 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
